scope: Correctly classify and remap AC1021 MLEADER proxy-cache layer indices from DWG control-record order to the emitted DXF LAYER table order, then determine the remaining strict whole-file blocker.

source.classificationCorrection: The 36 cached records in block *U0 are MLEADER (DRW::MLEADER == 28), not MLINE (DRW::MLINE == 27). Earlier p5 proxy sentinel, layer-slot and DIMASSOC receipts that call these MLINE caches are corrected by this receipt.

sourceResourceOrder.evidence: The optional DRW_DwgProxyGraphicsResourceOrderHandler receives the reader's layer and linetype name order after table parsing; dx_iface retains bounded copies and the physical transport helper compares both vectors exactly with dwgRW's source vectors.
sourceResourceOrder.linetypeSentinel: Opcode 18 payload 32767 is retained as its validated BYLAYER sentinel and is not treated as an ordinary table index.

implementation.behavior: For parsed AC1021 DWG MLEADER caches only, preflight validates that every indexed resource resolves and that at least one layer index can be mapped. Entity output clones the caller model, remaps opcode-16 layer indices to the current DXF LAYER row order, preserves sentinel linetypes and unknown well-framed chunks, and authorizes only the transformed AC1021 MLEADER cache for same-revision DXF output. Failed remaps leave the cache/output unchanged.
implementation.limitation: This does not qualify native rendering, all opcode/resource roles, or complete physical MLEADER document conversion. Exact MLEADER proxy-byte output/readback and simultaneous group-92 proxy-count/class-field readback still require an isolated generated control.
